title: Pin with a test that a \?\Volume{GUID}\ cwd is treated as unresolvable (no shell follow, no test credit)
outcome:
From the Claude /review-code of tm-5gi4 phase 2, round 13, Low; no code change needed.

Since tm-5gi4 phase 2, engram_network_path counts every Windows verbatim path that does not name a drive letter as possibly network. That includes local volumes mounted without a letter (\?\Volume{GUID}\), so a shell cd there is taken as lost and a test there gets no credit. The doc comment says this is intended and conservative. Add a focused test so the behaviour stays visible.
